shape.notes: The slice is the Spanish yes/no set, a two-member closed set (R-SEL-04), and both members are excluded and therefore known (R-EX-05). Nearby items were considered and left out as a different slice, not yes/no words: claro, vale, de acuerdo, por supuesto (agreement/assent), para nada (emphatic denial idiom), también/tampoco (agreeing with a statement), ¿verdad?/¿no? (tag questions). Padding with them would break R-SEL-02 and R-EX-06, so nothing is left to select.
